digest.component_or_area: Backend port scalar interface / reconciler vendor adapter seam
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) still contain direct imports of adapters.jira and acli_subprocess, violating the core/port separation required by epic bbf1 AC3.
The Backend Protocol must be extended with scalar read-only members: project (DIG-defaulted), query_project (un-defaulted), and assert_env_ready() to replace direct Jira adapter calls.

Environment readiness and assignee errors must be lifted to neutral exceptions (BackendEnvError and BackendAssigneeNotFoundError) defined on the Backend port, with Jira-specific implementations subclassing them.
All nested lazy imports of adapters.jira from within function bodies must be eliminated by rewiring consumers to route through backend instances or the registry seam.
The Backend Protocol, JiraBackend, FakeBackend, S2 contract suite, and ADR 0035 §(d) must all be updated to document and enforce the widened scalar interface.
